name: seis-public-install-state
description: Separate public SEIS Repo card availability from independent install and release proof without installing anything.

interface.shortDescription: Show public source, install-evidence, and release-gate state honestly.
interface.longDescription: Read bounded public SEIS Repo evidence to distinguish source-visible marketplace cards, local artifact validation, independent installation proof, and human release approval without installing packages, using credentials, changing files, or accessing the network.
defaultPrompt: Show the public SEIS Repo install state without installing or publishing anything.
Explain which SEIS Repo cards are source-visible, locally validated, independently proven, or still approval-gated.
